about_the_game:
Otterly Lost is a cozy, story-rich adventure about wonder, friendship, and finding where you belong. You play as Otto, a curious sea otter who got swept away from his mountain home after a strange and sudden natural disaster.

Carried downriver and into the open sea, Otto must now find his way back through an island full of wonders, secrets, and surprises.

This demo offers a glimpse into Otto's journey. Experience the beginning of the adventure while the full game is in development.

⛰️ Explore a vibrant island full of life and hidden corners

🌊 Dive beneath the waves to uncover underwater mysteries

🐚 Gather treasures and special items to boost your skills

🐢 Meet cute animals and help on their quests

🪨 Solve light puzzles and platforming challenges

Much like sea otters in nature, who play an important role in keeping marine ecosystems in harmony, Otto’s journey turns out to be about more than just getting home.

After a mysterious earthquake shakes the island, something feels off. Now it's up to you to set things right and restore the balance of nature! Along your journey, you will meet cute and sometimes mysterious animals, get to know them and their stories, lend a paw in their troubles, and slowly learn how everything is connected.

In this demo, discover the opening chapters of Otto's mission to understand what's happening on the island and begin helping its inhabitants.

It’s an open-world game, so you can go at your own pace and discover every corner of the island and the surrounding underwater.

Swim through mysterious caves, shipwrecks and kelp forests, glide above rocky canyons and sunny beaches, or simply roam through rich terrains and forests. Every step (or splash) uncovers something new: a story, a view, or a quiet moment to take in.

This demo features a curated section of the world where you can freely explore and experience Otto's movement and discovery at your leisure.

Otters know a thing or two about using tools, especially rocks! As you explore the island, you’ll gather useful gear to help you out: dig up hidden shells, smash through obstacles blocking your way, and zip across tricky gaps. You’ll also upgrade your natural abilities, learning to swim faster, jump higher, climb easier, and glide further.

This game is all about wandering, discovering, and helping others at your own pace. Along the way, you’ll face light platforming and puzzles that add just the right touch of challenge – fun, rewarding, and never too intense. It’s a warm, curious adventure where cozy exploration and playful problem-solving go paw in paw.

The demo introduces Otto's core abilities and tools, giving you a taste of the movement, upgrades, and gentle challenges that define the full experience.

Meet a lively bunch of island characters: funny, sweet, wise, bubbly, and even a little grumpy. Some could use your help, while others may guide you on your journey.

As you get to know them, hear their stories, and build friendships, you’ll take one step closer to restoring the island’s natural balance.

In this demo, meet some of the island's inhabitants and experience the heartwarming interactions and quests that bring Otto's world to life.

WHAT'S NOT IN THE DEMO & COMING IN THE FULL GAME:

  • Customize Your Looks - The full game lets you collect valuables by completing quests, solving puzzles, or exploring hidden corners, then trade them for cute outfits, quirky hats, and cozy accessories to express your otter self in style. From gliding through the air to splashing in the water, a touch of style fits everywhere. Who says otters can't have their own fashion?

  • More Areas to Explore - The demo offers a taste of the island, but the full game expands far beyond with additional biomes, underwater zones, and secret locations waiting to be discovered.

  • More Characters & Stories - Meet even more island inhabitants in the full game, each with their own personalities, backstories, and quests that deepen the narrative and your connection to the world.

  • Extended Collectibles - Beyond what's in the demo, the full game will include a wider variety of treasures to find.

  • More Languages - The demo is currently available in English only, but the full game will include localization in multiple languages to welcome otters from around the world.

short_description: Play as Otto, a curious sea otter swept far from home. Explore forests, dive underwater, glide over canyons, and climb your way back. Meet friendly animals, complete quests, and enjoy soft challenges at your own pace! This is a demo preview of the full game, currently in development.
